basics.description: Deploys the Papyrus appliance into your Azure subscription. Papyrus is a customer-hosted runtime for durable, event-driven agent work. Nothing about your workloads leaves your environment.

subLabel.preValidation: Choose the size and identity of the appliance.

options.text: This deploys a single Ubuntu 24.04 virtual machine running Papyrus as one container, plus a dedicated data disk for appliance state. Deployment takes 5-10 minutes, most of which is the container image pull.

elements.name: namePrefix
elements.label: Name prefix
elements.toolTip: Used to name every resource this deployment creates, for example papyrus-appliance.

validations.message: Use 3-20 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: Virtual machine size
elements.toolTip: Two vCPU and 8 GB is sufficient for the runtime. Choose a larger size only if you expect heavy concurrent use. The size must be available in your chosen region.

elements.name: securityType
elements.label: Security type
elements.toolTip: TrustedLaunch adds secure boot and a virtual TPM. It is the stronger posture, but it changes the boot chain, so use it only if your environment already standardises on it.

elements.name: dataDiskSizeGb
elements.label: Data disk size (GB)
elements.toolTip: A dedicated disk holds appliance state, so it survives a rebuild of the virtual machine.

subLabel.preValidation: Administrator access and how the appliance is reached.

elements.name: authenticationType
elements.label: Administrator authentication
elements.toolTip: Used only for administrative access to the virtual machine. The appliance itself is administered through its onboarding flow in a browser.

elements.name: adminUsername
elements.label: Administrator username
elements.toolTip: The local administrator account on the virtual machine. This is not an application account: Papyrus uses Microsoft Entra ID for identity, and creates no accounts of its own.

validations.message: Use lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or underscore.

elements.name: sshPublicKey
elements.label: SSH public key
elements.toolTip: Paste the contents of your public key file, for example ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub. Do not paste a private key.

validations.message: This does not look like an SSH public key. It should begin with ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa or ecdsa-sha2-nistp256.

elements.name: adminPassword
elements.label: Administrator password
elements.toolTip: 12-123 characters, with at least three of: lowercase, uppercase, digit, symbol.

validations.message: The password must be between 12 and 123 characters.

elements.name: createPublicIp
elements.label: Assign a public IP address
elements.toolTip: Required if the onboarding flow must be reachable from outside the virtual network. Turn this off for a restricted environment and reach the appliance over a private network.

elements.name: dnsLabelPrefix
elements.label: DNS name label (optional)
elements.toolTip: Gives the appliance a name of the form <label>.<region>.cloudapp.azure.com instead of a bare IP address.

validations.message: Use 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

elements.name: allowedSourceAddressPrefix
elements.label: Allowed source address
elements.toolTip: Which addresses may reach the administrator port and the onboarding port. A specific CIDR range is strongly recommended; * allows any address.

validations.message: Enter * or a CIDR range such as 203.0.113.10/32.
